work.prompt:
You are a worker in a build loop on the plotplot umbrella (jahala/plotplot). Make the check below pass, honestly. Nobody reviews your prose; only the verifier's verdict counts.

## The loop
docs/tend2/contracts.tend2.html is the umbrella's contracts loop. Its check 12 is the fit runner's git support (jahala/plotplot 60): a judge pinned by git rev in a garden.lock can be resolved and fetched by scripts/fit/lib.sh, the way a judge pinned by a platform tarball already is. Evidence: contracts/test/fit-git.test.sh, red today on every assertion after the first two.

## Your check (c12)
- (code) the fit runner resolves a judge pinned by git rev: `fit_lock_lookup` returns the url and rev the fixture lock carries for tend2, pleach and umbel, `fit_clone` checks out exactly that rev, and refuses when the clone's HEAD is not the rev asked for · evidence: contracts/test/fit-git.test.sh

## Read first
contracts/test/fit-git.test.sh (the whole test: what it calls and what it asserts), scripts/fit/lib.sh (the runner: fit_lock_lookup, fit_fetch, fit_verify_sha256, fit_extract, fit_clean_path, fit_run, fit_discard_scratch, and how it sources), scripts/fit/lock-lookup.mjs (the TOML lookup behind fit_lock_lookup: today it returns only version and the platform entry's url and sha256), contracts/lock.schema.json (the git variant: url plus a 40-hex rev), contracts/fixtures/garden.lock (tend2, pleach and umbel pinned by git), contracts/test/lock.test.sh and contracts/test/fit-runner.test.sh (both must stay green), CLAUDE.md, docs/building-the-garden.md §1 to §3.

## The change
- scripts/fit/lock-lookup.mjs: when the judge carries a `git` table, the printed JSON line carries `"git": {"url": ..., "rev": ...}` beside `version`; a judge with platforms keeps today's shape exactly (fit-runner.test.sh and lock.test.sh read it).
- scripts/fit/lib.sh: a new function `fit_clone <url> <rev> <dest>` that clones the url into dest at depth one (fetch the rev by sha when the server allows it, else clone and check out), verifies with `git rev-parse HEAD` that HEAD equals the rev, and on any mismatch or failure removes nothing it did not create, prints a one-line refusal naming the rev asked for and the rev found, and returns non-zero; dest does not exist on refusal. `file://` urls must work (the test uses one). No network in the tests.
- The usage comment at the top of lib.sh lists fit_clone with the other functions. Nothing else in lib.sh changes behaviour.

## Your environment
- You are at the repository root of an isolated git worktree of jahala/plotplot. Work here directly. Setup ran npm ci, cargo build --release and plotplot lock verify, so the planted hooks find their judges.
- Leave your changes in the working tree; do not create branches, commit, or push.
- Green is: `bash contracts/test/fit-git.test.sh` exits 0, and `npm test` exits 0 (it runs every contracts test; the reds it reports as recorded are owed by beds and are not yours; contracts/test/EXPECTED_RED lists fit-git.test.sh today, and you remove that line, because a recorded test that turns green fails the run until its line goes). `cargo test --quiet` must stay green; do not touch the crate.
- Probe and scratch files go in .loop-scratch/ only. If genuinely blocked, write BLOCKED.md at the repository root with what you tried, what stopped you and what a fix needs, instead of faking a green.
- Delete with trash, never rm (lib.sh has fit_discard_scratch for that). Never git reset. Never initialise a repository in place; create fixture repositories with `git -C <new-dir> init` the way the test does.

## Rules
- Solve the class, not the fixture: any judge with a git table resolves; any url git can clone.
- Never weaken the test to pass it.
- Production quality, the smallest honest change, prose in sentence case with no em dashes anywhere, including comments.
- Your FINAL message must end with one line of the form `Tried: YYYY-MM-DD <what you did, what you rejected and why, anything the next worker must know>`; the conductor transcribes it into the loop page.

## Your work, in order
1. Run `bash contracts/test/fit-git.test.sh` and confirm it fails for the right reason today: fit_lock_lookup returns no git url and rev, and fit_clone is undefined. The red evidence already exists on master; you do not write a failing test.
2. Implement the change above. Run `bash contracts/test/fit-git.test.sh`, `bash contracts/test/lock.test.sh` and `bash contracts/test/fit-runner.test.sh`; all three must exit 0. Remove the fit-git.test.sh line from contracts/test/EXPECTED_RED.
3. Run `npm test` and fix anything red that is yours. The conductor then runs weeder check --strict on your diff and the pinned tend2 verifier on check 12 of docs/tend2/contracts.tend2.html, whose evidence is the same test. Then stop, ending your final message with the dated Tried line.
